overview.text: Today's developments highlight major security concerns, corporate shifts, and rapid capability advancements across the artificial intelligence landscape. Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders, while separate security findings reveal that Claude Code's settings exposed sensitive passwords in public files. In corporate governance news, Nvidia's Board of Directors is investigating Jensen Huang. Meanwhile, the open-source and release ecosystems continue to evolve with new tools and models, including NousResearch releasing Arete-27B by post-training over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce western values, and kubai087 introducing kubai-icons as an agent skill for coding agents. Finally, industry analysis indicates that Anthropic may imminently meet the threshold of dramatically accelerated progress due to AI, coinciding with Google's TPU staking its claim on inference as a viable alternative to the CUDA moat.

entries.title: Goldman Sachs Is Pulling Claude Code from Its Bankers and Traders
entries.why: Highlights sudden enterprise risk management decisions regarding AI coding assistant deployments among major financial institutions.

entries.title: Goodbye Claude, hello Pi
entries.why: Reflects shifting developer preferences and adoption patterns away from Claude toward alternative conversational models.

entries.title: Nvidia Board of Directors Is Investigating Jensen Huang
entries.why: Signals unexpected internal leadership scrutiny at the center of the hardware accelerator market.

entries.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
entries.why: Exposes critical credential leakage vectors in automated developer tool configurations that researchers must mitigate.

entries.title: NousResearch/Arete-27B · Hugging Face (Qwen finetune)
entries.summary: https://huggingface.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF from NousResearch: Arete-27B We post-trained over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce western values on a Chinese-trained model. We call this new model Arete-27B.
entries.why: Demonstrates post-training intervention techniques applied to base models to alter alignment properties.

entries.title: kubai087/kubai-icons
entries.summary: An agent skill that draws animated icons in one consistent style, for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents. Comes with 2,600+ open-source icons for React, Vue and SVG, and a website to browse them. · JavaScript
entries.why: Provides specialized visual asset generation capabilities directly integrated into existing coding agent workflows.

entries.title: speridlabs/idol
entries.why: Advances multimodal image-to-3D generation pipelines for spatial computing and asset creation.

entries.title: Ajeya: AI is dramatically accelerating AI research right now
entries.summary: Earlier this week, Anthropic stated in their S1 that they “may imminently meet” the threshold of “dramatically accelerated progress due to AI” as defined in their Responsible Scaling Policy.
entries.why: Marks a critical threshold where AI systems begin recursively accelerating their own research and development loops.

entries.title: Notes on Take-Off Speeds and RSI
entries.summary: I created these notes for use when I facilitate AI safety courses. I'm sharing these notes early because this issue is topical and I suspect it is better to make an imperfect version available early rather than a much more polished version available later.
entries.why: Offers structured perspectives on takeoff speeds and recursive self-improvement relevant to AI safety.

entries.title: The Iron(wood) Throne: Google's TPU Stakes Its Claim on Inference
entries.summary: Viable Alternative of CUDA Moat, NVIDIA scared and working nights & weekends, Jensen’s Counter Submission, Kimi K3, Muse Spark Open, Qwen, GLM5.3, TorchTPU, vLLM, SGLang, llm-d, Ray
entries.why: Analyzes the shifting competitive dynamics of AI inference hardware and the challenge to existing software moats.
